item.title: Find company emails and phone numbers from a website
item.description: How to collect role addresses (info@, sales@) and phone numbers from a company's own website, what not to scrape, and a hosted Actor that reads the site instead of a third-party database.

item.title: Get a company logo and social links from a domain
item.description: How to find a company's logo, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub and TikTok URLs from its own website, and a hosted Actor that returns them as one profile per domain.

item.title: Export Google Trends related queries and rising search terms
item.description: How to pull top and rising related queries (including Breakout terms) from Google Trends, why unofficial clients often get a 429, and a hosted option that returns them as rows.

item.title: Google Trends Trending Now API — daily trending searches
item.description: Google publishes a public Trending Now RSS feed per country, with around 10 rising searches, approximate traffic and news. How to read it for free, and a hosted Actor if you want a scheduled history.

item.title: Recruitee jobs API — export a public board to JSON
item.description: Recruitee publishes a free, keyless jobs API at /api/offers. Here is the endpoint, what it returns, and a hosted Actor that maps Recruitee openings onto the same schema as Greenhouse and Lever.

item.title: Google Ads Transparency Center API — what exists, and what does not
item.description: There is no official API for the Google Ads Transparency Center. The free BigQuery dataset covers ads shown in the EEA or Turkey. Here is how to query that, and how to export ads for any country.

item.title: How to compare more than 5 Google Trends keywords on one scale
item.description: Google Trends rescales every comparison to 0–100, and the unofficial explore endpoint accepts five terms at a time. Here is the anchor-keyword method, and a hosted option that does the chaining for you.

item.title: Official Google Trends API — alpha access, and what to use until then
item.description: Google announced a Trends API in July 2025. It is still an alpha you have to apply for. Here is what it offers, and practical options if you need Trends data today.

item.title: pytrends 429 error (TooManyRequestsError) — causes and fixes
item.description: pytrends raises TooManyRequestsError when Google Trends answers HTTP 429. Why it happens, free fixes that still work, and a hosted option if you have to run this on a schedule.

item.title: Shopify products.json 250 limit — how to page a full catalog
item.description: Shopify's public products.json endpoint returns at most 250 products per request and ignores a larger limit. How to paginate correctly, when a short page is not the end, and what to do on very large catalogs.

item.title: SmartRecruiters jobs API — public postings, paged with offset
item.description: SmartRecruiters publishes a public postings API that needs no key. It pages with limit and offset, and the list payload does not include the full job description. Here is a working request, and a hosted feed for mixed ATS boards.

item.title: Website screenshot API in Python — full-page captures, or a hosted option
item.description: How to take a full-page website screenshot in Python with Playwright, what usually breaks in bulk, and a pay-per-successful-capture API for PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF.

item.title: Workable jobs API — public board postings as JSON
item.description: Workable's public widget endpoint returns a company's open jobs as JSON, with no API key. Here is the URL, what it returns, and a hosted feed if you also need Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby in the same schema.
